name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
summary: In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden calls travelers to the Green Belt. He seeks help to ease the threats disturbing the marsh’s balance.

sections.title: Tending the Wounds
sections.body:
Rethiel calls on travelers who pity the Wetlands to help ease its suffering. Mosshide gnolls ravage the wildlife and burn the marsh’s living trees with crude flints. He urges travelers to hunt them and take those flints away.

Diseased fen creepers also fester in the marsh waters. Rethiel asks that they be thinned, in the hope that these efforts will bring peace back to the wounded soil.

sections.title: Guardian of the Marsh
sections.body: From damp thickets in the Green Belt, Rethiel watches over the marsh. His towering form is made of moss, peat, and primal plant life. Unlike the bog beasts that roam as aggressive predators, he is conscious and speaks with sorrow. He feels the Wetlands as a living ecosystem, suffering from foreign predation and corruption.

faq.answer: Rethiel is a sentient bog beast in the Wetlands’ Green Belt. Unlike the mindless creatures of his kind, he speaks with mortals and protects the marsh.
Rethiel can be found in the Green Belt, northeast of Dun Algaz in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want travelers to help him?
faq.answer: Rethiel senses the marsh suffering under invasive threats. He asks travelers to confront destructive Mosshide gnolls, take the crude flints they use to set marsh trees ablaze, and thin diseased fen creepers to bring relief to the land.

faq.q: Are all bog beasts sentient like Rethiel?
faq.answer: Most bog beasts across Azeroth act on hostile instinct and lack higher intellect. Rethiel is exceptional: his deep natural attunement gives him sapience and speech.

faq.q: What threats does Rethiel focus on?
faq.answer: Rethiel seeks to curb aggressive Mosshide gnolls, take away their crude flints used to burn living wood, and thin diseased fen creepers festering in the marsh.

faq.q: Is Rethiel aligned with the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Rethiel is friendly to the Alliance and hostile to the Horde. He cares for the land and calls on Alliance travelers willing to mend the marsh.

angles.text: As a druid, you may recognize Rethiel as an unusual expression of Azeroth’s wild balance. He speaks directly for a wounded ecosystem, much like the ancient protectors of Kalimdor.
As a shaman, you may sense Rethiel’s attunement to the marsh’s elemental and physical disharmony. He echoes the distress of the land itself as it groans under contamination and fire.
